notes: Data, not code: the job-function vocabulary and every cue phrase live here so a cue change is a map-version change, not a silent remap.
The vocabulary is the mission's job-function vocabulary and must not be extended here. UNCLASSIFIED is a legitimate output, not a bug.
These classes describe the FUNCTION a posting performs (research, engineering, commercial...), not seniority and not the hiring company.
Matching is deterministic and lexical: title and description text only, whole phrases, case-insensitive, whitespace-tolerant. No model, no network, no learned weights.
A title cue names the occupation, which is why a title hit outranks any number of description hits; a long description contains almost every phrase eventually.

This map, together with medradar/recruitment/taxonomy.py, is the deterministic A arm of the Phase-4 job-text extraction experiment; the local-model B arm (Qwen3-4B) is compared against it on the same postings. The baseline is deliberately simple, lexical and reproducible; it is not a language model.

Longest/most specific title evidence wins: title_score for a class is the summed length (in characters) of the distinct title phrases that matched. This mirrors the existing device taxonomy's 'longest keyword wins' discipline.

Description cues are a fallback used only when no title cue matched. They require at least min_description_hits distinct phrases and a strict lead over the runner-up; otherwise the posting is UNCLASSIFIED rather than guessed.

matching.title_rule: per class, take the first occurrence of each matched title phrase and greedily keep non-overlapping phrases longest-first (nested phrases such as 'research' inside 'research scientist' are not double counted); title_score = summed character length of those kept phrases; highest title_score wins; tie -> the class whose matched title phrase starts earliest in the title (the head of the occupation phrase); remaining tie -> class precedence (lower number first); still tied -> UNCLASSIFIED ambiguous_title_tie
matching.description_rule: only when title_score is zero for every class; use description cues with distinct-phrase counts; a class must reach min_description_hits and lead every other class strictly; otherwise UNCLASSIFIED
matching.rationale_zh: 标题决定职业身份；描述只作兜底，且证据不足时弃权而不是硬分。

CORE_R&D.definition_en: Discovers or develops technology: research scientists and R&D engineers working on new concepts, prototypes, materials, algorithms or processes rather than on an existing product line's incremental support.
CORE_R&D.notes: Bare 'research' is a title cue because a title names the occupation; in descriptions only multi-word research phrases are used.

CLINICAL_R&D.definition_en: Generates clinical evidence: trial design and operations, clinical science, biostatistics, medical affairs and clinical evidence strategy. Not the field clinical specialist who supports sales (that is SALES_ADMIN_OTHER).
CLINICAL_R&D.notes: The field 'Clinical Specialist' / 'EP Mapping Specialist' support commercial procedures; those phrases are deliberately assigned to SALES_ADMIN_OTHER and are not clinical-research cues.

PRODUCT_ENGINEERING.definition_en: Turns a technology into a released product: product/design/development, systems, test and verification engineering, design assurance, mechanical design.
PRODUCT_ENGINEERING.notes: Mechanical design is product engineering; electrical/electronics/systems hardware is HARDWARE_SYSTEMS.

ALGORITHM_SOFTWARE.definition_en: Writes and ships software: application, platform, cloud and DevOps engineering, embedded software/firmware, data and machine-learning engineering, algorithm implementation.
ALGORITHM_SOFTWARE.notes: Firmware/embedded software is treated as software function; the device taxonomy owns the technology track, this class owns the job function.

HARDWARE_SYSTEMS.definition_en: Designs physical electronics and system hardware: electrical/electronic, PCB, sensors, power, optics, reliability engineering, systems hardware integration.
HARDWARE_SYSTEMS.notes: 'systems engineer' appears in both PRODUCT_ENGINEERING and HARDWARE_SYSTEMS; per-class title_score ties are broken by precedence, and the class list keeps the more specific system-hardware phrases here.

MANUFACTURING_PROCESS.definition_en: Runs and improves production: manufacturing/process/production engineering, equipment and maintenance engineering, lean/six-sigma, tooling, assembly processes.
MANUFACTURING_PROCESS.notes: Maintenance/repair of plant equipment is a manufacturing-process function, not an R&D function.

QUALITY_REGULATORY.definition_en: Assures product quality and regulatory compliance: quality engineering and systems, regulatory affairs and submissions, audits, CAPA, post-market surveillance, validation.
QUALITY_REGULATORY.notes: Quality/regulatory roles support products; the track gate still lets them carry the product-area track, but analysis must not read that as an R&D direction.

SALES_ADMIN_OTHER.name_en: Commercial, field-service, administrative and other non-R&D
SALES_ADMIN_OTHER.name_zh: 销售、现场服务、行政及其他非研发
SALES_ADMIN_OTHER.definition_en: Commercial, field clinical/technical support, marketing, training & education, finance, supply chain, administration, production operators and other professional roles that are not research, engineering, manufacturing-process or quality/regulatory work.
SALES_ADMIN_OTHER.notes: Deliberately broad because the mission's vocabulary folds every non-R&D job into one class; the definition is 'not research/engineering/manufacturing/quality', so field clinical specialists and mapping specialists belong here, and the technology-track gate refuses to attach a device track to them.

UNCLASSIFIED.definition_en: No rule fired, or the rules conflict/are too weak to decide. This is an accepted research outcome and must be counted, never silently filled with the company's most common class.
UNCLASSIFIED.notes: Reachable when (a) no cue matches title or description, (b) a title tie survives precedence, (c) the description fallback has no class with the required distinct hits, or (d) two description classes tie.

track_gate.generic_keywords_reason_en: The device taxonomy was built for product-code text, where these phrases are specific. In job adverts they occur in ordinary engineering prose ('next generation of CRM software') and in benefits boilerplate ('dental, vision'). They never assign a track on their own; a match is retained as ambient evidence with generic=true for audit.
track_gate.ineligible_reason_en: A commercial/administrative/abstained posting must not carry a technology track: a device keyword in a sales advert is the product being sold, not a technology signal. The candidate evidence is retained for audit, the track is not assigned.
track_gate.eligible_note_en: A track is a product-technology area. For QUALITY_REGULATORY / MANUFACTURING_PROCESS postings the track describes the product area the role supports, which is not by itself an R&D direction; downstream analysis must gate on function class.
